diagnosis.upload_tip: Dipholo tse di siameng: lesedi le le siameng, gaufi le sebaka se se amegeng
diagnosis.what_to_do: Se o tshwanetse go se dira jaanong

foot and mouth.spreads_by: Kopano le leruo le lweleng, mafelo a a amegeng
foot and mouth.what_to_do: Arola leruo le lweleng ka bonako. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo kgotsa ofisi ya DVS. Se tsamaise leruo. Begela balaodi, bolwetsi jwa tlhako le molomo ke bolwetsi jo bo begiwang mo pusong.
foot and mouth.symptoms: Mabutswi mo dinao, molomong le lelémeng. Molapo o feteletseng, go sa je, pholo e e fokotsegile.
foot and mouth.prevention: Entiwa ya metlha, thibela go tsamaisa leruo, dirisa dikgato tsa tshireletso ya bophelo.

goat pox.spreads_by: Kopano le leruo tse di lweleng, mowa
goat pox.what_to_do: Arola leruo. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo go bona kalafi. Enta leruo tse di itekanetse go sireletsa.
goat pox.symptoms: Diphupho tse di tshogileng mo letlalong, feberu, molapo wa nko, go thata go hema.
goat pox.prevention: Entiwa ya ngwaga le ngwaga, tlhokomelo ya leruo, efoga kopano le leruo tse di lweleng.

healthy cattle.urgency: Ga go na se se tlhokegang
healthy cattle.what_to_do: Dikgomo tsa gago di bonala di itekanetseng. Tswelela go di lebelela ka metlha, di ente le go di fepa sentle.
healthy cattle.symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi.
healthy cattle.prevention: Boloka ditlhatlhobo tsa metlha, dientiwa le metsi a a hlwekisitsweng le dijo tse di siameng.

healthy chicken.urgency: Ga go na se se tlhokegang
healthy chicken.what_to_do: Dikgogo tsa gago di bonala di itekanetseng. Tswelela go di lebelela ka metlha le go di tlhokomela sentle.
healthy chicken.symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi.
healthy chicken.prevention: Boloka tshireletso ya bophelo, dientiwa tsa metlha, madulo a a hlwekisitsweng.

healthy goat.urgency: Ga go na se se tlhokegang
healthy goat.what_to_do: Dipodi tsa gago di bonala di itekanetseng. Tswelela go di lebelela ka metlha le go di tlhokomela sentle.
healthy goat.symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi.
healthy goat.prevention: Boloka ditlhatlhobo tsa metlha, dientiwa le metsi a a hlwekisitsweng le dijo tse di siameng.

lumpy cow disease.spreads_by: Dikeledi (dimosetlhe, diphefo), kopano le leruo tse di lweleng
lumpy cow disease.what_to_do: Arola dikgomo tse di amegeng. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo go bona kalafi. Enta lolelo lote. Laola dikeledi mo tshimong.
lumpy cow disease.symptoms: Ditshwepe tse di phahamileng mo mmeleng, feberu, molapo wa nko, pholo e e fokotsegile, maotwana a a bidibala.
lumpy cow disease.prevention: Entiwa ya ngwaga le ngwaga, taolo ya dikeledi, tlhokomelo ya leruo.

salmonella.spreads_by: Dijo le metsi a a konaletsweng, masepa
salmonella.what_to_do: Arola leruo tse di amegeng. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo go bona kalafi. Hlwekisa madulo. Lekola merano ya dijo le metsi.
salmonella.symptoms: Maphoko, go lapa, pholo e e fokotsegile, go swa ga dino tse di monnye.
salmonella.prevention: Metsi a a hlwekisitsweng le dijo tse di siameng, tshireletso ya bophelo, thibela dinonyane tsa naga mo mafelong a dikgogo.

coccidiosis.spreads_by: Dijo, metsi le mabu a a konaletsweng
coccidiosis.what_to_do: Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo go bona meriana. Hlwekisa le go omisa madulo. Arola dino tse di monnye go tswa go tse di godileng.
coccidiosis.symptoms: Maphoko a a nang le madi, go lapa, khulo e e bosula, mmala o o sa tlwaelegang mo dikgogong.
coccidiosis.prevention: Madulo a a omileng a a hlwekisitsweng, efoga go tletlega, diriisa dijo tse di sireleditsweng mo dinong tse di monnye.

watermelon mosaic virus.spreads_by: Dikeledi tsa aphid, dimela tse di konaletsweng
watermelon mosaic virus.what_to_do: Tlosa mme o senya dimela tse di konaletsweng. Laola palo ya diaphid ka setlhare. Se jale melegapu gaufi le mafelo a a konaletsweng.
watermelon mosaic virus.symptoms: Mmala wa botala jo bo sootho-botala o o garologaneng mo matlharen, leungo le le sennang sebopego le le le nonneng, khulo e e emeng.
watermelon mosaic virus.prevention: Diriisa mefuta e e ganang bolwetsi, laola diaphid, tlosa magora fa gare ga tshimo.

healthy watermelon.urgency: Ga go na se se tlhokegang
healthy watermelon.what_to_do: Legapu la gago le bonala le itekanetseng. Tswelela go le lebelela ka metlha, go le nesa le go le fepa sentle.
healthy watermelon.symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi.
healthy watermelon.prevention: Boloka tshireletso ya dibjalo, laola dikeledi, netefatsa go nesa go go siameng.

sorghum cereal grain mold.spreads_by: Dipora tsa obomela, pula e e feteletseng
sorghum cereal grain mold.what_to_do: Kotula pele ga nako mo dikgaolong tse di nang le pula e ntsi. Omisa lebese ka bonako morago ga kotulo. Diriisa setlhare sa obomela fa o bona matshwao pele.
sorghum cereal grain mold.symptoms: Mmala wa boshibidu kgotsa obomela mo dihlohlong tsa lebese, lebese le le senang boleng.
sorghum cereal grain mold.prevention: Diriisa mefuta e e ganang obomela, efoga go diegelwa ga kotulo, tokafatsa go ntsha metsi mo tshimong.

sorghum covered kernel smut.spreads_by: Dipora tse di mo molapon, peo e e konaletsweng
sorghum covered kernel smut.urgency: Alafa peo pele ga go jala
sorghum covered kernel smut.what_to_do: Se jale peo e e konaletsweng. Alafa peo ka setlhare sa obomela pele ga go jala. Diriisa phuthologo ya dibjalo.
sorghum covered kernel smut.symptoms: Lebese le le nang le obomela o o apareditsweng ke letlalo, pholo e e fokotsegile thata.
sorghum covered kernel smut.prevention: Diriisa peo e e hlwekisitsweng, diteramente tsa peo, phuthologo ya dibjalo.

potato late blight.spreads_by: Dipora tsa obomela tse di thusiwang ke mowa, pula
potato late blight.what_to_do: Diriisa setlhare ka bonako. Tlosa mme o senya dimela tse di konaletsweng. Efoga go nesa mo godimo ga matlhare.
potato late blight.symptoms: Dinkatla tse di fifetseng tsa metsi mo matlharen le matlhobong, obomela o o tshweu mo tlase ga matlhare, mekwelo e e bofeng.
potato late blight.prevention: Diriisa mefuta e e ganang bolwetsi, diriisa setlhare sa thibelo sa obomela, efoga maemo a a omeletseng.

tomato late blight.spreads_by: Dipora tsa obomela tse di thusiwang ke mowa, pula
tomato late blight.what_to_do: Diriisa setlhare ka bonako. Tlosa mme o senya dimela tse di konaletsweng. Efoga go nesa mo godimo ga matlhare.
tomato late blight.symptoms: Dinkatla tse di fifetseng tsa metsi mo matlharen le leungong, obomela o o tshweu mo tlase, go wela ga semela ka bonako.
tomato late blight.prevention: Diriisa mefuta e e ganang bolwetsi, diriisa setlhare sa thibelo sa obomela, tokafatsa go gololosega ga mowa.

healthy potato.urgency: Ga go na se se tlhokegang
healthy potato.what_to_do: Semela sa gago se bonala se itekanetseng. Tswelela go se lebelela ka metlha le go se tlhokomela sentle.
healthy potato.symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi.
healthy potato.prevention: Boloka tshireletso ya dibjalo, laola dikeledi, netefatsa go nesa go go siameng.

healthy tomato.prevention: Boloka tshireletso ya dibjalo, laola dikeledi, netefatsa go nesa go go siameng.
